fatal.reason: OPEN DEFECT (Plan A outcome, Family C) awaiting Phase B fix, NOT an adjudicated/acceptable FATAL. `helper` (a `const fn`) is called only from the const initializer `const VALUE: i32 = helper();`, which is not inside any enumerated function's body -- walk.rs walks only `f.source(db).value.body()`, and a const/static initializer expression is neither a function body itself nor contained in one. rustc traces const evaluation and considers `helper` live (no dead_code warning; only `really_dead`, which is genuinely unused, is flagged); the helper has no incoming edge to `helper` and it is not a root (private fn), so it reads dead.
